A fresh session sees it at startup; the session that ran the refinem"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ent receives an adoption context message on its next step."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Propose** — two proposers edit the harness: `INV` changes how the agent works; `DOM` adds what a"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" practitioner of the domain knows. Proposals are the edited files, not patch descriptions.
- **Probe"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"** — each candidate runs the same task in an isolated copy of the workspace. The evidence is the tra"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"jectory, the artifact, and whether the run delivered.
- **Compose** — one composer merges, adopts, o"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"r keeps the base, with a specific supporting moment for each decision.
- **Select** — an anonymous s"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"elector compares rendered deliverables, not harnesses. Base is included as a conservative check; a n"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"o-op winner is not adopted.
- **Reflect** — writes what each edit did and at most one transferable l"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"esson into `.dsh-harness2/library/<domain>/`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Read docs/method.md for the full method, the eight components, the DSH mapping, and the differences "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"from the reference release."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### The editable harness"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The harness lives at `.dsh-harness2/harness/`:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| File | Role | Cost |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `system.md` | role and procedure | always on |
| `guardrails.md` | standing rules | always on |

| `tool-guidance.md` | how to use tools | alway"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"s on |
| `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | on-demand workflow | loaded only when invoked |
| `sub_agents/<n"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ame>/AGENT.md` | delegated role | separate context |
| `scripts/<name>.py` | deterministic helper | "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"run on demand |

Candidate middleware plugins are not executed by this build."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Override the plugin entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or via `--patch`):"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| `dataDir` | `.dsh-harness2` | Harness, library, and run data. |
| `maxAlwaysOnChars` | `12000` | C"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ap for the four always-on files. |
| `maxK` | `3` | Maximum recursion budget accepted by the tool. |"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"
| `mode` | `sequential` | Default recursion mode. |
| `concurrency` | `2` | Parallel child agents p"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"er phase. |
| `timeoutMinutes` | `20` | Per-child-agent timeout. |
| `toolTimeoutMinutes` | `120` | "},{"id":"p38s5","text":"Cooperative timeout for the whole refine tool. |
| `maxWorkspaceMB` | `50` | Copy cap; larger worksp"},{"id":"p38s6","text":"aces need a smaller path or `isolation: shared`. |
| `workspaceIsolation` | `copy` | `copy` = one wo"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"rkspace copy per probe; `shared` = run in place (can interfere). |
| `selection` | `true` | Anonymou"},{"id":"p38s8","text":"s selection; if false, adopt the best successful final. |
| `reflection` | `true` | Write the experi"},{"id":"p38s9","text":"ence record after adoption. |
| `libraryLessons` | `3` | Recent lessons injected into ordinary agent"},{"id":"p38s10","text":"s. |
| `libraryEntries` | `8` | Library entries copied into a proposer context. |
| `model` / `provi"},{"id":"p38s11","text":"der` / `reasoningEffort` | session default | Override the child-agent route. |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Data layout"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"`runs/` and `workspaces/` are ignored by the data directory's `.gitignore`; `harness/` and `library/"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"` can be committed if you want to version the improvement."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"- Each probe runs the real task in a copy of the workspace. Side effects are contained by `copy`, bu"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"t the child uses your DSH profile's tools and permissions; review your permission preset before usin"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"g this on sensitive data.
- Candidate middleware plugins are guidance, not executed. Skills, scripts"},{"id":"p43s4","text":", subagents, and prompt text are the supported levers.
- `shared` isolation runs probes in place and"},{"id":"p43s5","text":" can produce collisions; it exists for workspaces too large to copy, not as the default.
- Selection"},{"id":"p43s6","text":" compares deliverables using the model, not a ground-truth grader. It is evidence, not a score.
- Ru"},{"id":"p43s7","text":"ns are expensive. `k=1` is the default; `k>1` multiplies model calls.
- The tool can switch the plug"},{"id":"p43s8","text":"in instance to another workspace via its `workspace` argument, but only one workspace is active per "},{"id":"p43s9","text":"nother workspace via its `workspace` argument, but only one workspace is active per plugin instance."}],"truncated":true}
